title: UTF-16 font advance
summary: Recover the x86 thiscall font width summation at 0x456450, including primary and single alternate glyph scans, fallback and line-break advances.
test_description: Compare original and recovered returns, MXCSR, and unchanged font, glyph, and text storage for null and empty strings, primary and alternate hits, duplicate glyphs, misses, CR/LF, surrogate code units, empty ranges, no alternate, and rounding modes.
known_limits: Original 32-bit layout and valid terminated strings and glyph ranges are required; invalid pointers and concurrent mutations are not tested.
Names and meanings of unknown fields are unresolved; alternate lookup does not recurse.
Exceptional floating-point payloads and unmasked traps are not exhaustively characterized; compiler optimization can affect floating-point details.
